extDescription.message: Stop Netflix autoplay previews, and add Picture-in-Picture with subtitles, auto skip intro, speed control and more

popupBlock.message: Stop autoplay previews on the browse page

popupNextEpisode.message: At the end of an episode

nextImmediate.message: Go to the next episode as soon as credits start

nextStop.message: Don't continue to the next episode

popupShortcutsHelp.message: [ / ]: speed −/+0.25 (0.25–3x)   \: normal speed   N: next episode

popupPipHelp.message: On the player, Alt+P opens the browser's own PiP (no subtitles; ±10s and next episode), and Alt+Shift+P opens a floating window with subtitles and controls. Press the same keys again to return.

popupPipKeys.message: In the window: Space play/pause   ←/→ 10s   ↑/↓ volume   M mute   C fit to video   [ ] speed   N next episode
